Cluster Logic

Prompt 1: What holds the Buddhist Philosophers cluster together as a recognizable branch or school?

Buddhist Philosophers gathers a set of questions that should be read together.

This cluster belongs in Philosophers because it repeatedly returns to what survives when a thinker is treated as a living method of inquiry instead of a summary label.

The philosophers branch is strongest when it preserves voice, context, and method. A thinker should not be flattened into a doctrine if the style of thinking is part of the contribution.

The connective question is not merely “what belongs under Buddhist Philosophers?” but “what becomes clearer when these pages are read as a family rather than as isolated posts?”

Internal Tensions

Prompt 3: Where do the strongest tensions or disagreements appear inside Buddhist Philosophers?

Buddhist Philosophers becomes more useful when its internal tensions stay visible.

The pressure is canon without encounter: turning philosophers into monuments, slogans, or quick alignments instead of letting their arguments and temperaments disturb the reader.

The point of preserving the cluster is not to make it look settled. It is to keep the reader oriented while the sub-pages do their sharper work.

A strong expansion of this cluster would add short bridge notes between neighboring pages, so a reader can see why Nagarjuna and Dogen belong in the same conversation without needing a secret map and a miner's helmet.
